author: Blaise Pascal
text: All of humanity's problems stem from man's inability to sit quietly in a room alone.

author: Henry David Thoreau
text: Our life is frittered away by detail. Simplify, simplify.

author: Seneca
text: It is not that we have a short time to live, but that we waste a lot of it.

author: Marcus Aurelius
text: Very little is needed to make a happy life.

author: Lao Tzu
text: Nature does not hurry, yet everything is accomplished.

author: Ralph Waldo Emerson
text: Adopt the pace of nature: her secret is patience.

author: Henry David Thoreau
text: The price of anything is the amount of life you exchange for it.

author: Seneca
text: Wherever you go, there you are a guest, unless you are with yourself.

author: Marcus Aurelius
text: You have power over your mind, not outside events. Realize this, and you will find strength.

author: Epictetus
text: Wealth consists not in having great possessions, but in having few wants.

author: Walt Whitman
text: Re-examine all you have been told. Dismiss what insults your soul.

author: Henry David Thoreau
text: It is not enough to be busy. The question is: what are we busy about?

author: Seneca
text: Begin at once to live, and count each separate day as a separate life.

author: Marcus Aurelius
text: Do every act of your life as though it were the very last act of your life.

author: Lao Tzu
text: To the mind that is still, the whole universe surrenders.

author: Ralph Waldo Emerson
text: Finish each day and be done with it.

author: Epictetus
text: First say to yourself what you would be; and then do what you have to do.

author: Henry David Thoreau
text: I went to the woods because I wished to live deliberately.

author: Marcus Aurelius
text: The happiness of your life depends upon the quality of your thoughts.

author: Lao Tzu
text: Silence is a source of great strength.

author: Ralph Waldo Emerson
text: Write it on your heart that every day is the best day in the year.

author: Blaise Pascal
text: I have made this longer than usual because I have not had time to make it shorter.

author: Marcus Aurelius
text: Waste no more time arguing about what a good man should be. Be one.

author: Henry David Thoreau
text: Go confidently in the direction of your dreams.

author: Lao Tzu
text: A journey of a thousand miles begins with a single step.

author: Hans Hofmann
text: The ability to simplify means to eliminate the unnecessary so that the necessary may speak.

author: Seneca
text: While we are postponing, life speeds by.

author: Henry David Thoreau
text: Many go fishing all their lives without knowing it is not fish they are after.

author: Marcus Aurelius
text: Look within. Within is the fountain of good.
